```{r}

# Load in demographic data
demo_dat <- read_xpt("/Users/lucaskearns/personal_projects/nhanes/data/nhanes_2021-2023_date_2026-10-12/2021-2023_Demographics/DEMO_L.xpt")

# Load in examination data
balance_dat <- read_xpt("/Users/lucaskearns/personal_projects/nhanes/data/nhanes_2021-2023_date_2026-10-12/2021-2023_Examination/BAX_L.xpt")
blood_pressure_dat <- read_xpt("/Users/lucaskearns/personal_projects/nhanes/data/nhanes_2021-2023_date_2026-10-12/2021-2023_Examination/BPXO_L.xpt")
body_measure_dat <- read_xpt("/Users/lucaskearns/personal_projects/nhanes/data/nhanes_2021-2023_date_2026-10-12/2021-2023_Examination/BMX_L.xpt")
liver_ultrasound_dat <- read_xpt("/Users/lucaskearns/personal_projects/nhanes/data/nhanes_2021-2023_date_2026-10-12/2021-2023_Examination/LUX_L.xpt")

# Add DEMO data for easier investigation
demo_balance_dat <- balance_dat %>%
  inner_join(demo_dat, by = "SEQN")
demo_blood_pressure_dat <- blood_pressure_dat %>%
  inner_join(demo_dat, by = "SEQN")
demo_body_measure_dat <- body_measure_dat %>%
  inner_join(demo_dat, by = "SEQN")
demo_liver_ultrasound_dat <- liver_ultrasound_dat %>%
  inner_join(demo_dat, by = "SEQN")

```

Body Measure Dat
```{r}
# Weight
# Population
# Adults vs Children
# 10 year bins
# Males vs females
demo_body_measure_dat <- demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  mutate(weight_lbs = BMXWT * 2.205,
         gender = case_when(RIAGENDR == 1 ~ "Male",
                            RIAGENDR == 2 ~ "Female"))

demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(weight_lbs)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Weight (lbs)")

demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(weight_lbs, fill = RIDAGEYR < 18)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Weight (lbs)")



# Looking at adult weight
median_everyone <- demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR > 18) %>%
  pull(weight_lbs) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR > 18) %>%
  ggplot(aes(weight_lbs)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Weight (lbs)") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_everyone,
             linetype = "dashed")


male_med_bw <- demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR > 18,
         gender == "Male") %>%
  pull(weight_lbs) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

female_med_bw <- demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR > 18,
         gender == "Female") %>%
  pull(weight_lbs) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

demo_body_measure_dat %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR > 18) %>%
  ggplot(aes(weight_lbs, fill = gender )) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Weight (lbs)") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = male_med_bw,
             linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = female_med_bw,
             linetype = "dashed")
```
